pictures.scene: Canaletto, The Bacino di San Marco — the Doge's Palace and the long waterfront of the city standing above a wide basin crowded with gondolas and moored trading boats under a pale sky, then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me, come, i will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters

pictures.scene: Bloch, In a Roman Tavern — a woman in gold tipping a glass of red wine to her lips while a man in a white shirt with a red sash leans back from the table and looks away, the kings of the earth were immoral with her, and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality
pictures.name: pd_bloch_in_een_romeinse_herberg

pictures.scene: Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — torn scarlet clouds streaming across the whole sky above an empty lake and black wooded hills with no road and no figure anywhere on it, and the angel carried me away in the spirit into a wilderness, where i saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Petrus Christus, A Goldsmith in His Shop — a goldsmith in red holding a small balance over loose gold coins while the shelves behind him carry gilt cups and rings and strung pearls and branches of coral, the woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, she held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations
pictures.name: pd_christus_goldsmith

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — the king in a gold brocade robe and a turbaned crown wrenching round from his own table as a hand writes burning letters on the wall beside him, and on her forehead a mysterious name was written, babylon the great, the mother of prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Procession to Calvary — a great crowd streaming out over the fields to the place of execution with the fallen cross bearer at the centre of it and the mourning women held back in the foreground, i could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for jesus, and i was utterly amazed at the sight of her
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_the_procession_to_calvary

pictures.scene: Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — the archangel in gold armour and a crimson cloak with his wings spread and his sword lifted, standing on a scaly horned beast with red eyes while a kneeling donor in brocade holds an open book at the left, why are you so amazed said the angel, i will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, A Cavern near Naples — the black mouth of a sea cave opening in a great arch of broken rock onto a still pale bay with a watchtower on the far shore, the beast that you saw was, and now is no more, but is about to come up out of the abyss and go to its destruction
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_a_cavern_near_naples

pictures.scene: Dou, Old Woman Reading a Lectionary — an old woman in a fur lined cloak and a linen headcloth holding a heavy printed book up close to her eyes in the lamplight, and those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be
pictures.name: pd_dou_old_woman_reading_a_lectionary

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Morning in the Riesengebirge — range behind range of hazy blue mountains running out to the horizon at sunrise with a thin crucifix on the red rock summit and a woman in white standing beside it, this calls for a mind with wisdom, the seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_morning_in_the_riesengebirge

pictures.scene: Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — a crowned king in a gold brocade mantle holding out a tall gilt vessel with his attendants in velvet and turbans pressed close behind him at the wall of the ruin, there are also seven kings, five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come, but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_adoration_of_the_kings

pictures.scene: Cole, The Course of Empire Desolation — one ivy grown column still standing with a bird's nest on its capital above the broken colonnades and the empty bridge of a city that has no one left in it, the beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king, who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction
pictures.name: pd_cole_the_course_of_empire_desolation

pictures.scene: Van Huchtenburgh, Cavalry Battle — a rider in a plumed hat driving his black horse forward with his sword out while the smoke of the muskets drifts behind and men and horses lie fallen across the foreground, the ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast
pictures.name: pd_van_huchtenburgh_cavalry_battle

pictures.scene: Schwoiser, Henry at Canossa — the emperor in a penitent's plain robe waiting bare headed against the castle wall while a guard in the gateway points him back and a prelate in red watches from the gallery above, these kings have one purpose, to yield their power and authority to the beast
pictures.name: pd_schwoiser_heinrich_vor_canossa

pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Lamb — the Lamb standing in a ring of light with a cross staff and banner while the four living creatures shine around it and the palm bearing multitude and the crowned elders fill the ground below, they will make war against the lamb, and the lamb will triumph over them, because he is lord of lords and king of kings
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Province — a huge crowd of every rank walking a wide dusty road under gold banners with a priest in a flowered chasuble at the right and a lame boy striding ahead on his crutch, then the angel said to me, the waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: Turner, The Burning of the Houses of Parliament — a wall of white gold fire going up into the whole sky above the river with the towers standing black inside it and the crowd watching from the bank below, and the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute, they will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire
pictures.name: pd_turner_the_burning_of_the_houses_of_parliament

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Moses with the Tablets of the Law — Moses in a pale robe lifting the two dark written tablets high above his head with both hands against the bare hillside, for god has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of god are fulfilled
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_moses_with_the_tablets_of_the_law

pictures.scene: Bellini, Procession in the Piazza San Marco — the gold mosaics and bronze horses of the great basilica standing over a square filled with a long procession of brothers in white carrying candles behind a gilt canopy, and the woman you saw is the great city, that rules over the kings of the earth
pictures.name: pd_bellini_procession_piazza_san_marco

lines.text: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me,
Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.
The kings of the earth were immoral with her,
and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality.
And the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness,
where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls.
She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her immorality.
And on her forehead a mysterious name was written:
BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and witnesses for Jesus.
And I was utterly amazed at the sight of her.
Why are you so amazed? said the angel.
I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
The beast that you saw was, and now is no more,
but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction.
And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world
will marvel when they see the beast that was, and is not, and yet will be.
This calls for a mind with wisdom.
The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
There are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, and the other has not yet come;
but when he does come, he must remain for only a little while.
The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king,
who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom,
but will receive one hour of authority as kings, along with the beast.
These kings have one purpose:
to yield their power and authority to the beast.
They will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will triumph over them,
because He is Lord of lords and King of kings, and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones.
Then the angel said to me, The waters you saw, where the prostitute was seated,
are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.
And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute.
They will leave her desolate and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast,
until the words of God are fulfilled.
And the woman you saw is the great city
that rules over the kings of the earth.
